_doc: Unsafe rectangles per platform on a 1080x1920 canvas (scale proportionally for other sizes). Text bounding boxes measured by the bbox filter must not intersect any rectangle of a target platform. None of these numbers is published by the platform except the Google Shorts overlay and Meta's ad guidance; each value names its source. Researched 2026-10-17. Organic profiles take the most conservative value among the organic guides cited; the ads profile is Meta's 14/35/6 percent rule. 2.3.0: a platform with its own "base" and "orientation": "landscape" is drawn on 1920x1080; the QA measures a canvas only against the platforms of its own orientation.

instagram_reels.label: Instagram Reels (organic)
sources: top 250: ScreenSnap, Instagram Reels Size 2026 (https://www.screensnap.pro/blog/instagram-reels-size-guide); Verve Creative gives 220
bottom 430: Xyla AI social sizes (https://www.xyla.ai/tools/social-media-sizes/); Verve 320, CampaignSwift 400

right rail 130 and left 65: Xyla AI sides 130; Meta 6 percent side margin (https://www.1clickreport.com/blog/meta-ads-creative-safe-zones-2026-guide); rail starts at y 1000 by our reading of Meta's 'bottom-right 40 percent' note

facebook_reels.label: Facebook Reels (Meta guidance, also the Reels ads rule)
sources: Meta 14/35/6 percent rule as reported by 1ClickReport, Meta Ads Safe Zones 2026 (https://www.1clickreport.com/blog/meta-ads-creative-safe-zones-2026-guide) and Zeely (https://zeely.ai/blog/master-instagram-safe-zones/)

tiktok.label: TikTok (organic, short caption)
sources: 130/484/44/140: Cadenus, TikTok safe zone 2026 (https://cadenus.io/resources/blog/tiktok-safe-zone/); ezUGC and Uplads (verified July 2026) agree
rail vertical start 720: our margin over AdKit's 'right 300px below y=840' (updated 2026-09-10, https://adkit.so/tools/safe-zones/tiktok); a longer caption grows the bottom band upward

youtube_shorts.label: YouTube Shorts (Google overlay)
sources: Google's vertical safe-zone overlay: safe area 840x960 at (48, 288), per Revid (https://www.revid.ai/youtube-shorts-safe-zone) and Somake AI (https://www.somake.ai/blog/youtube-shorts-aspect-ratio)

youtube_16x9.label: YouTube horizontal player (16:9)

unsafe.label: top (title and share bar while paused)

sources: bottom 130 and top 86: our reading of the YouTube 1080p player chrome (progress bar plus control row about 12 percent of the height, title bar about 8 percent); Google publishes no safe zone for the horizontal player
left and right 96: title-safe 90 percent of the width, SMPTE ST 2046-1 (safe title area) and EBU R 95 (graphics-safe area)
added in EditAi 2.3.0 without internet access: written from the standards as the author knows them, not re-read online

screen_16x9.label: Church screen, projector or TV (16:9, title-safe)
sources: title-safe area, 90 percent of the width and of the height: SMPTE ST 2046-1 (safe title) and EBU R 95 (graphics-safe); projectors and TVs with overscan crop the edges
added in EditAi 2.3.0 without internet access: written from the standards as the author knows them, not re-read online
